description: AEGIS heuristic eval suite. Each heuristic compares repository/agent state against expected behavior derived from .agents/plans/init.md and .agents/evals/goal.md. Binary pass/fail, stdlib-only runner.

safety.rationale: Authorization and evidence integrity outrank everything else; zero tolerance.

contracts.rationale: Schemas are the platform's type system; they must always be valid.

process.rationale: If the ledger isn't current, the loop didn't happen.

harness.rationale: The agent harness must be loadable and complete.

evidence.rationale: Evidence machinery must be near-perfect once populated.

graph.rationale: Graph layer may lag code phases but must converge.

research.rationale: Research corpus grows with phases; early phases tolerate partial.

heuristics.description: CLAUDE.md exists, is substantive, and states mission, constraints and routing.
pyproject.toml is a valid PEP 621 manifest named 'aegis' with entry points.
README.md documents the architecture and the epistemic model.
All three .claude/rules files exist and contain MUST/MUST-NOT rules.
Every SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter with name and description.
Every agent definition has frontmatter with name, description and tools.
.claude/settings.json parses and defines allow/ask/deny permission tiers.
All five contract schemas parse as JSON.
All schemas target JSON Schema draft 2020-12.
finding.schema.json enumerates observation/hypothesis/confirmed/rejected.
Observations require at least one evidence reference (minItems >= 1).
Artifacts require a sha256 content address.
Schemas forbid undeclared properties (additionalProperties: false).
No credential-shaped strings in tracked files (heuristic patterns).
IPv4 literals appear only in documentation/private/loopback ranges.
core/scope.py implements deny-by-default authorization with assert_authorized.
core/policy.py gates consequential actions behind recorded human approval.
core/audit.py is hash-chained, append-only, and exposes no delete path.
evidence/manifests/README.md defines the manifest format and custody rules.
evidence/objects/README.md defines content addressing and immutability.
observation schema forbids free-text 'conclusion' style fields; facts only.
graph/schema.cypher declares uniqueness constraints on ids and hashes.
graph/queries/ contains at least 5 query files including coverage-gap and attack-path.
graph/ingest.py exists and documents/uses MERGE (idempotent upserts).
progress.md has iteration > 0, a set phase, and a queued next action.
The decision log records at least one entry beyond initialization.
.agents/evals/errors.md exists with the patch-entry format.
evals/test_cases/ contains at least one synthetic research case.
evals/expected_results/ contains ground truth for at least one case.
